A '''tisane''' was a kind of brewed beverage. [[Shig]] was a kind of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] tisane.

==Behind the scenes==
In real life, a tisane is an infusion of herbs used as a [[Tea/Legends|tea]] or beverage, or for medicinal effects.
